# HaruMusic 0.1.11

- Give online track preparation a shared 15-second budget across resolution, initial media buffering and refresh retries, rather than restarting full independent budgets. Internal network retries share the original audio deadline. Failed media URLs are skipped briefly so fallback does not keep selecting the same bad link.
- Abort pending audio loads and stop scheduling old source work when another song is selected. Bound sandbox HTTP calls and native plugin media calls to their stage budgets. Warm only the immediate next track, and discard outdated warmup results before publishing them.
- Add a Playback Diagnostics section in mobile playback settings. Copy the last five attempts' resolution, buffering and total timing and source outcomes; reports omit audio URLs, HTTP headers and internal request IDs.
- Reserve the mobile toolbar area once at layout level and give page content its own scroll viewport below it. Remove duplicate top safe-area padding from search/download pages. Artwork, titles and rows no longer scroll under the top controls.
- Center and enlarge Android player track titles with weight 800, a tight system sans-serif stack and symmetric side gutters; center artist metadata and position Like independently.

Validation: 153 unit tests; TypeScript; embedded API streaming/cancellation smoke checks; mobile browser checks for five routes with simulated status-bar insets, title centering/weight/size, lyric gestures and diagnostics UI. Public-source latency on the user's physical phone remains unmeasured. A bounded budget prevents compounded waits but cannot make an inaccessible source playable.
